svg.text: K9 EINHAND — one hand, one deck, one washer
One gantry hand on the rear wall works loose ware on a household hob, a turned oven and one washer.
wall width 3600 mm · 600 deep · 2200 high (cell P + O 1350 mm)
7 motion actuators in the cell (9 with oven door and hatch drawer) · 4 dynamic seals
est. cost: appliances ≈ 3.4–3.9 k€ + machine part ≈ 7.8–13.8 k€
transport gallery z 2000–2200 (boxes to every module)
same scale in both views (1 : 25 at 1600 px)
TOP VIEW (deck level, rear wall at top)
S speed spindle · S0 cup scale · E egg fixture · DG drain gully · WC waste chute · J jet gate

g.text: −250 g on the wrist load cell

svg.text: 1 box tipped, dosed by the wrist load cell
6 oven loaded through the side door
7 plated on the hatch drawer tray
8 dishes returned, scraps to the chute
THE ONE HAND (5 axes, no tool changer)
X 1440 mm, belt in the rear dry box, 1.5 m/s
Z 1000 mm on the hanging mast (y 0–120)
Y 440 mm along the closed arm tube
roll ∞, 30 Nm: pours, flips, turns spit and screw
EPM tang chuck ≈ 400 N, 6-axis load cell
lifts ≤ 6 kg; no tilt about x: tangs face the rear
T turntable and S spindle: canned magnet
Mast range X 1680–3120; the oven and the washer are reached by pushing ware in +X.

g.text: 1/9 Box fetched: the hand takes the opened GN box by its tang from the box shelf and tips it over the pot; the wrist load cell doses 250 g (±3 g).
2/9 Peel: apple on the fork-spit; the roll turns it while Y draws it past the blade post on the PS socket (1 mm depth shoe).
3/9 Dice: apple into the screw cassette on PS; the roll turns the screw (30 Nm → 2.5 kN) and pushes it through the 10 mm grid.
4/9 Stir: paddle into the pot on HR2; interval stirring, 20–30 s every 1–3 min, as a home cook does.
5/9 Pan-pair flip: flip pan set on the Ø 280 pan on HF1, the pair rolled 180° in 0.8 s; the pancake lands in the flip pan.
6/9 Oven: the side-hinged door swings along the front wall; the hand pushes the GN 2/3 tray in +X onto the oven rails.
7/9 Plate: plate from the dispenser (z 1900) to the hatch drawer tray, food ladled on; the drawer slides 300 mm out to serve.
8/9 Return: dishes come back on the drawer; the hand tips the scraps over the waste chute WC.
9/9 Wash: items rolled on edge, pushed in +X through the side door onto the rack; 10 min hold at 70 °C (A0 ≈ 60).
